status: debt service financing feasibility ONLY; not an All-in/Rebuild sports simulation

configuration.team: CP6k Team 0 only; other five teams in unchanged CP6k paths
configuration.formula: mandatory = ceil(remaining debt / remaining follow-up checks)
configuration.noRefinance: installments must be paid from annual salary-cap headroom without another draw
configuration.oneYearInvestment: extra one-year payroll equals full original unspent cap plus new borrowing; not an executable asset purchase
configuration.rebuild: 5/10/15% unused 2027 cap TARGET; additional salary relief computed, NO automatic cap rollover
configuration.missing: new actual player salaries beyond 2027, player availability, buyer-side cap and slots, pick-asset transfer, C-add retained cut charges, debt ledger for other 5 teams, enforcement hard-failure
